items.changelog:
- Initial release of the PDF manipulation toolkit.
- Supports text and table extraction, PDF creation, merging, splitting, metadata extraction, and rotation.
- Guides for handling scanned PDFs (OCR), password protection, watermarking, and image extraction.
- Provides command-line tool usage (pdftotext, qpdf, pdftk, pdfimages).
- Recipes and code examples for Python libraries: pypdf, pdfplumber, and reportlab.
- Quick reference and next steps included for users needing advanced or form-related workflows.
